Scarlet ChampionPassive
Instant
Your damaging critical strikes now increase your Holy damage dealt by 2% for 20 sec. stacking 5 times. Can only occur once per sec.

At 5 stacks, you are granted High General.
High General
Your next Chastise consumes all stacks of Scarlet Champion to deal 25% increased direct damage, and be guaranteed to critically strike.
